seed: At Next defaults, no flag set: the 60 minute reference edit, long enough that every track paints its clips, its cuts and the gaps between its clips as one layer (the-timeline-of-an-hour-long-edit-scrolls-zooms). V2's first B-roll starts twenty to thirty seconds in, so 0:10 on V2 is always a gap. A person rests the pointer in that gap and right clicks it: the gap's own menu comes up, Ripple Delete first, exactly as on a quiet lane where every gap is a view of its own.

steps.comment: The pointer comes to rest in the gap on V2 at 0:10, before the first B-roll.
A right click where it rests offers the gap's own rows, Ripple Delete first.

steps.note: THE RIGHT CLICK: the painted gap at 0:10 on V2 offers Ripple Delete first
